description: A home daycare provider needs to organize their state licensing compliance checklist. Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/daycare_licensing_tracker.xlsx which contains 8 initial requirements. Add 7 more requirements from different categories (Safety, Training, Legal, Facility, Operations). Set realistic status (Complete/In Progress/Not Started) and priority (High/Medium/Low) for each. Create a Completion % column (column H) with a formula calculating percentage of Complete items. Apply conditional formatting to Status column (Green=Complete, Yellow=In Progress, Red=Not Started). Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
